description: This file defines security configuration for the catalog-service using Spring Security. It configures OAuth2 resource server with JWT validation, disables CSRF, and sets authorization rules for various endpoints.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Spring Security configuration class that sets up security filter chain, endpoint access rules, and JWT-based OAuth2 resource server authentication.

methods.name: securityFilterChain
methods.description: Defines the security filter chain with endpoint authorization rules and OAuth2 JWT configuration.
